title: Putting Analytics: Validate Make Rates and Expected Putts Against Published Data and Calibrate Skill Presets
body:
Part of #14168. Follows the fleet deferred-validation standard: acceptance that needs external data is recorded and deferred, never faked.

## Scope
- Reference data with provenance: Broadie (2014) tour make % and expected putts by distance (already cited for `sg_optimizer.shot_model.putting`), PGA Tour ShotLink where licensed, and published amateur make-rate tables.
- Calibrate tour / scratch / 10 / 20 handicap stroke and read dispersions so the simulated make-% curve on the library falls within the reference band; record the fit, residuals and assumptions.
- A test that the calibrated tour profile reproduces the reference make-% curve within stated tolerance, and that the derived E_player(d) is within tolerance of the tour expected-putts table.

## Acceptance
- No preset is called calibrated without the provenance record and residuals.
- If licensed data is unavailable, the issue stays open with a deferred-validation entry rather than tuning to the model's own output.
